page_title: RBL 2-2 WOL | RB Leipzig v Wolfsburg 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar.
90+5' Here's the change. Adam Daghim leaves the pitch and Jonas Adjetey (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 2 Goal! Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top left corner. 2:2.
87' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
86' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
84' Substitution. Lovro Majer will be replaced by Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is coming onto the pitch as Mohamed Amoura cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Here is a change. Antonio Nusa is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig).
82' Substitution. Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolas Seiwald walks off.
81' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
80' The attendance for today's match is 35787.

78' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Jeanuel Belocian slips the ball through to Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
78' Having seen unsporting behavior, Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Marius Muller (Wolfsburg) is the recipient.

73' What a chance! Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
70' 1 - 1 Goal! Brajan Gruda tees up Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:1.
66' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
63' The game is interrupted. Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
63' Substitution. Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) has come on for Conrad Harder.
63' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Benjamin Henrichs and he is replaced by Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig).
60' Substitution. Kento Shiogai makes his way off the pitch and Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) comes on as his replacement.
59' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
56' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.

52' 0 - 1 Goal! Adam Daghim finds Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the top left corner. Fantasy football! 0:1.
51' Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
49' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) connects with a cross inside the box and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to keep it out. World class save!
48' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck had an easy-decision to make.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+1' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Kamil Grabara was alert and the score remained the same.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
44' The ball is cleared after Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolfsburg.
41' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

41' Great save! Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Kamil Grabara. Corner kick. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity.
36' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.

34' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Kamil Grabara, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
32' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
30' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
29' Ole Werner is forced to make a change. Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Maarten Vandevoordt.
28' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and it's Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

27' A neat pass is well received by Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
20' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

19' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Kamil Grabara pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going under the crossbar.
18' Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
11' None of the RB Leipzig players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.

10' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the left side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Kamil Grabara. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar.
7' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from RB Leipzig as they win a corner.
5' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) collects a cross from the free kick and unleashes a shot towards the goal. However, it isn't precise at all and the ball goes miles over the crossbar.
4' Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
4' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
2' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is able to continue to play.
1' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Wolfsburg will take the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck will officiate today.
